description: Get the details of a service for a tenant having Azure AD Premium license and is onboarded to Azure Active Directory Connect Health.

operations.description: Gets the details of a service for a tenant having Azure AD Premium license and is onboarded to Azure Active Directory Connect Health.

consts.description: The version of the API to be used with the client request.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: The count of alerts that are currently active for the service.
props.name: activeAlerts

props.description: The additional information related to the service.
props.name: additionalInformation

props.description: The date and time, in UTC, when the service was onboarded to Azure Active Directory Connect Health.
props.name: createdDate

props.description: The list of additional emails that are configured to receive notifications about the service.
props.name: customNotificationEmails

props.description: Indicates if the service is disabled or not.
props.name: disabled

props.description: The display name of the service.
props.name: displayName

props.description: The health of the service.
props.name: health

props.description: The id of the service.
props.name: id

props.description: The date and time, in UTC, when the service was last disabled.
props.name: lastDisabled

props.description: The date or time , in UTC, when the service properties were last updated.
props.name: lastUpdated

props.description: The monitoring configuration of the service which determines what activities are monitored by Azure Active Directory Connect Health.
props.name: monitoringConfigurationsComputed

props.description: The customized monitoring configuration of the service which determines what activities are monitored by Azure Active Directory Connect Health.
props.name: monitoringConfigurationsCustomized

props.description: Indicates if email notification is enabled or not.
props.name: notificationEmailEnabled

props.description: Indicates if email notification is enabled for global administrators of the tenant.
props.name: notificationEmailEnabledForGlobalAdmins

props.description: The list of emails to whom service notifications will be sent.
props.name: notificationEmails

props.description: Indicates if email notification is enabled for global administrators of the tenant.
props.name: notificationEmailsEnabledForGlobalAdmins

props.description: Gets the original disable state.
props.name: originalDisabledState

props.description: The total count of alerts that has been resolved for the service.
props.name: resolvedAlerts

props.description: The id of the service.
props.name: serviceId

props.description: The name of the service.
props.name: serviceName

props.description: The signature of the service.
props.name: signature

props.description: List of service specific configuration properties.
props.name: simpleProperties

props.description: The id of the tenant to which the service is registered to.
props.name: tenantId

props.description: The service type for the services onboarded to Azure Active Directory Connect Health. Depending on whether the service is monitoring, ADFS, Sync or ADDS roles, the service type can either be AdFederationService or AadSyncService or AdDomainService.
props.name: type
